title: Global Yudovich-type solutions to a reduced model for micropolar fluids with zero viscosity
summary: In this paper, we study the well-posedeness at low regularity of a two-dimensional system obtained as a reduced model for micropolar fluid dynamics. At the mathematical level, the system presents a coupling between an Euler-type equation for the two-dimensional velocity field of the fluid and an advection-diffusion equation for the scalar microrotation field. For this model, we prove global existence and uniqueness of Yudovich-type solutions, namely weak solutions for which the vorticity is only bounded (with some additional integrability property) and the microrotation field remains bounded…
